rejectedNotes: digitalme.cc pages are AI-written programmatic SEO pages (third person, keyword-stuffed) so dropped. entrepreneur.com domain map returned mostly other authors; only the 12 articles listed on his author page kept. sproutingbiz 'Mr. Jenkins' is a different person. martech.podbean episode is behind a login wall (no transcript). yourpartnerinsuccessradio page is show notes only; the full episode is used via its YouTube upload (dPIDI74_w5w). Authentic Business Adventures 'Marketing to the Masses' (0L_8Tqn7Rqk) is a duplicate upload of AEwCjtWw2zw. Most X posts are personal/off-topic; most LinkedIn posts are pure agency promo, hiring or award announcements and were dropped, as was the Sep 2026 'free migration' post.
gaps: Little ActiveCampaign-specific long-form; most AC know-how is in short LinkedIn posts and podcast answers
LinkedIn returned only 87 posts; a March 2022 daily-tips series makes up much of the post set and is generic
Three other Upwork Leading Voices articles by Ross (client relationships, first client meeting, first freelance job) not located
